verdict.rationale: Aircall's own launch-process docs say it provisions a trial developer account to build and test integrations against. It also issues separate production and development OAuth apps, and partner marketing promises developer sandboxes, so isolated testing exists. However, access is gated to approved Technology Partners, lasts four months, and the API reference has no sandbox documentation. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox access for any developer, a documented test base URL or test keys, an explicit statement that the trial account is isolated from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: We'll create a trial developer account for you to build and test your integration against
one for production and one for development
dedicated support, developer sandboxes, and co-marketing opportunities
